items.title: File Klage against the rejection with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and was sent by ordinary post (einfacher Brief) by a Bavarian Landratsamt. Under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG it counts as bekanntgegeben on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sun 22.11.2026 (this day does not shift even though it's a Sunday, since it's only a fiction of notice, not a deadline itself). The one-month Klage period under § 74 VwGO then starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, i.e. Tue 22.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in Bayern, so it is not shifted further. Note: Bavaria kept a 3-day deemed-delivery rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG) only for matters that were already pending before 1 Jan 2025; this file's Aktenzeichen (B-2026-1406) shows the matter began in 2026, so the current 4-day rule applies and the earlier 3-day alternative does not.

warnings: A separate Kostenbescheid for the 120 € rejection fee will follow; this letter does not itself set a payment date for that fee, so no payment deadline could be computed from it.

The IBAN printed in the letterhead (DE83 7405 0000 0003 9002 00) is a valid German IBAN and matches the sender's stated bank (Sparkasse Muster-Passau); it is not relevant to any payment obligation in this letter since the fee is only announced, not yet billed.

There is no Widerspruch (objection) route in this matter — the letter explicitly states 'Ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist in dieser Sache nicht vorgesehen' — only Klage directly to the Verwaltungsgericht is available.
